The mechanical snakeboard developed here in the Laboratory for Intelligent Mechanical Systems, LIMS, tries to reproduce the motion of a person riding a snakeboard. In place of a rider, the mechanical snakeboard has two motors and a flywheel. One motor rotates the steering wheels and the other rotates the massive flywheel, which acts as the human torso.
